issue: Does the new-evidence exception for successive habeas petitions (28 U.S.C. § 2255(h)(1) and the parallel § 2244(b)(2)(B)(ii) provision) reach challenges to a death sentence?

sides.position: The new-evidence provision in § 2244(b)(2)(B)(ii) encompasses challenges to death sentences.
The new-evidence provision in § 2255(h)(1) (and § 2244(b)(2)(B)(ii)) does not encompass challenges to death sentences.

quote: We limit this holding by noting a circuit split on the scope of the new evidence provision in § 2254(b)(2)(B)(ii) and § 2255(h)(1) in death penalty cases.
